structures.label: Trachea
structures.function: Conducts air toward the main bronchi.

structures.label: Carina
structures.function: Ridge at the point where the trachea divides into the main bronchi.

structures.label: Right main bronchus
structures.function: Conducts air from the trachea into the right lung.

structures.label: Left main bronchus
structures.function: Conducts air from the trachea into the left lung.

structures.label: Right upper lobe
structures.function: Superior lobe of the right lung.

structures.label: Right middle lobe
structures.function: Middle lobe unique to the right lung.

structures.label: Right lower lobe
structures.function: Inferior lobe of the right lung.

structures.label: Left upper lobe
structures.function: Superior lobe of the left lung.

structures.label: Left lower lobe
structures.function: Inferior lobe of the left lung.

structures.label: Horizontal fissure
structures.function: Separates the right upper and middle lobes.

structures.label: Right oblique fissure
structures.function: Separates the right lower lobe from the upper and middle lobes.

structures.label: Left oblique fissure
structures.function: Separates the left upper and lower lobes.

structures.label: Bronchioles
structures.function: Small airways that conduct air toward respiratory regions.

structures.label: Alveoli
structures.function: Microscopic air spaces where gas exchange occurs across the blood-air barrier.
